name: app-lilac-gradient-finance-app-with-ghost-lettering
title: Lilac Finance App with Ghost Lettering
whatItIs: A cover with a phone showing a light finance home (large balance, action buttons, hatched bar chart) against a lilac-to-white gradient with huge faint 'FOLIO' lettering.
whatItMeans: Soft violet and white feel calm and modern. Hatched bars are a light touch of texture in an otherwise airy screen.
techniques: Ghost brand name behind the phone
Gradient fading to white toward the bottom
Hatched bars with one solid highlighted bar
Big balance figure with small cents
Pill action buttons in a row

vocabulary.definition: A bar filled with fine lines to look lighter than solid.
A row of pill buttons for the main actions.
A gradient ending in white to blend into the page.
